nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{D}$ be the closed unit disc in $\mathbb{R}^2$ and let $\omega$ be the restriction of Lebesgue measure to $\mathbb{D}$. $\mathrm{Homeo}_c(\mathbb{D}, \omega)$ is the subgroup of the group of homeomorphisms of $\mathbb{D}$ consisting of the homeomorphisms $\phi$ that preserve $\omega$ and whose support, the closure of $\{x \in \mathbb{D} : \phi(x) \neq x\}$, is contained in the open unit disc.
nodes.title: Area-preserving homeomorphisms of the disc supported in the interior

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{D} \subseteq \mathbb{R}^2$ be the closed unit disc and let $\omega$ be the restriction of Lebesgue measure to $\mathbb{D}$.
